Enter the Number Nexus, a world where logic and quick thinking collide! Numbered boxes fall from above, and it&rsquo;s your job to place them wisely. When two blocks of the same value meet, they merge into a single higher number, freeing up space and boosting your score. Every move matters: stack carefully, chain your merges, and keep the board clear while chasing ever-larger numbers. The more you combine, the higher your score climbs&mdash;and the closer you get to mastering the nexus of numbers. With endless possibilities and addictive gameplay, Number Nexus is the perfect test of strategy, foresight, and mathematical mastery. Make your mark!

Space Stairwell is a fast-paced survival game. You control a sphere and must jump up an endless series of platforms rising from the bottom of the screen. The goal is to survive as long as possible by completing levels. Every jump consumes energy, so you must collect items to recharge. The game gets harder in higher levels, with platforms that collapse faster and require quicker reflexes. You can unlock new levels by successfully completing the previous ones.

Instructions

Controls The game can be played on both Mobile and PC Mobile Jump Tap directly on the platform you want to jump to PC Jump Click with your mouse on the platform you want to jump to Slide Use the A D or the Left Right Arrow Keys to slide Smart-J
